name: 2-D-PROG
definition: The 2-D version of the MLZC algorithm, used as a benchmark for 2-D systems and for independent encoding of subbands in the 3-D/2-D approach.
summary: 2-D-PROG is a bi-dimensional MLZC variant that optimizes lossless medical data compression via spatial support and interband conditioning, distinguishing itself from JPEG2000 through specific MLZC integration.
